test.result: 19 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed. Synthetic three-name concentration is limited to two ranked names and a sector exposure ceiling, with the residual allocated to CASH.

implemented: The shared portfolio optimizer can cap active names by ranking expected net alpha, with deterministic name tie-breaking.
An optional sector ceiling proportionally scales excess sector weight down and leaves the balance in explicit CASH.
The optimizer refuses prior books that already violate frozen position or sector limits and fails closed if turnover constraints prevent attaining the position cap.
Signal allocation passes the diversification constraints through to the shared target optimizer.
blockers: Name count, sector identities and limits are caller-supplied and are not pinned into all strategy charters/runners.
Sector exposure controls are opt-in; no automated point-in-time sector master integration is claimed.
The optimizer does not reallocate sector-capped weight to other sectors, favoring conservative cash; prospective allocation quality is unmeasured.
scope_note: Common optimizer supports tested count and sector ceilings with cash fallback. Standardized policy, sector provenance and system-wide use remain incomplete.
